description: Use this when the user asks how the data center market looks overall, across all markets: ONE global DC Hub index, not a per-market score, and it takes no arguments (no market filter). Returns a global pulse score (0-100), dataset totals (tracked facility records, pipeline GW, deals in the last 90 days, substations), a heat map of the highest-scoring markets and the top markets by score. Answers "how is the data center market overall right now", "which markets lead DC Hub's index". Try: get_intelligence_index (no arguments). Global snapshot only; do NOT use for one market's score or verdict (use get_market_dcpi_rank), one market's full metric set (use get_market_intel) or to rank markets with filters (use rank_markets). For multi-step data center or energy questions, start with execute_plan.
name: get_intelligence_index
title: Market Intelligence Index
